title: 3 programming languages that will die by 2028

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Did you know three programming languages are set to disappear by 2028?

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: This matters because they’re still used in legacy systems and by thousands of developers.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: COBOL, Visual Basic 6, and Perl are the ones most at risk of fading away.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: COBOL, for example, is still used in banking but lacks modern support and updates.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Legacy systems in finance and government will struggle to maintain these languages.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: The key takeaway? Future-proof your skills by learning modern alternatives.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: What’s one language you think will disappear — and why?
